## Outline

- What are embeddings? Why are they useful?
- Text embeddings: Word2Vec
- MiniLM, Sentence Transformers
- Using pretrained models as feature extractors
- Brief demo or mention of object detection (YOLO)
- Image embeddings: ResNet / ViT feature extractors, Image classification with pretrained CNNs (e.g., ResNet)
- Clustering with image embeddings 
- Multimodal & zero-shot: HuggingFace zero-shot classification pipeline, CLIP: text-to-image and image-to-text similarity
